# FVD Layer Proposal v3.1

Detailed design specification for the Finite Volume Discretization layer.

## Overview

The FVD layer provides a high-level API for solving hyperbolic PDEs on sparse geometries using finite volume methods.

## Key Components

### System Concept

- `FiniteVolumeSystem` concept requirements
- Conserved and primitive variable types
- Flux computation interfaces

### Solver Design

- Policy-based design (templates, no virtual functions)
- Reconstruction schemes (MUSCL with limiters)
- Numerical fluxes (Rusanov, HLLC, Roe)
- Time integrators (RK1, RK2, RK3)

### Geometry API

- Fluent geometry builder
- Support for complex shapes (cylinders, boxes)
- Dynamic geometry modification

## GPU Compatibility

The design ensures GPU compatibility by avoiding:
- Runtime polymorphism (virtual functions)
- Dynamic memory allocation in kernels
- Standard library containers on device
